title: 台北捷運淡水信義線~Taipei Metro Tamsui–Xinyi Line
focus: 高密度都市幹線月台人流與行車協同~Dense urban trunk platform flow and train coordination
summary: 以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。~Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 capacity=17647.06 persons/hour；單元 2 得 dwell=24.76042 s；單元 3 得 combined_sigma=0.08534378 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 headway 的擾動測試，結果改為 16042.78 persons/hour；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives capacity=17647.06 persons/hour; unit 2 gives dwell=24.76042 s; unit 3 gives combined_sigma=0.08534378 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing headway in the first unit changes its result to 16042.78 persons/hour. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：1997 年：淡水線開始營運成為臺北捷運早期路線；2013 年：信義線於十一月通車延伸南北運輸走廊。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以淡水信義線的市區與郊區運輸情境為背景，設計一個連接轉乘站與終端站的排隊實驗。分別處理旅客到站、上車、關門及折返事件，並把地下車站的排水、通風和導航失效納入復原討論。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 1997: The Tamsui line opened as an early Taipei Metro route; 2013: The Xinyi line opened in November and extended the north-south corridor. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use the Tamsui–Xinyi corridor as a setting for a queueing experiment linking an interchange and a terminus. Treat arrivals, boarding, closure and reversal as separate events. Include underground station drainage, ventilation and localisation failures in the recovery discussion so that line capacity is tested against station and infrastructure constraints. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.title: 班距與有效運能~Headway and usable capacity
units.mechanism: 每小時運能由列車可用容量與通過頻率共同決定，平均班距縮短不代表每個車站都能吸收人流。車門交換、轉乘尖峰與不均勻到站會讓理論運能無法實現，容量計算應同時報告負載分布。 此式計算的是通過指定斷面的名目服務率，不能表示月台能容納多少人。需求在空間或時間上集中時，某站可以過載，即使整條線的平均載客率仍低。 讓尖峰轉乘需求與線上可用運能使用相同的時間窗比較。~Hourly capacity combines usable train capacity with passage frequency. A shorter average headway does not ensure every station can absorb the passenger flow. Door exchange, transfer surges and irregular arrivals can prevent the theoretical rate from being realised, so occupancy distribution must accompany the capacity estimate. This expression estimates a nominal service rate across a specified section, not how many people a platform can hold. Concentrated demand can overload one station even when average occupancy across the complete line remains relatively low. Compare peak interchange demand and usable line capacity over the same time window.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train；計算：capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour。敏感度：headway 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 s/train，其餘固定，結果為 16042.78 persons/hour。模型邊界：固定班距且每列都能使用指定容量；不包含站台壅塞及服務波動。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=900 persons/train; headway=183.6 s/train; calculation: capacity=3600*people/headway=17647.06 persons/hour. Sensitivity: headway, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 s/train, with all other inputs fixed, gives 16042.78 persons/hour. Model boundary: Fixed headway with the stated usable capacity on every train; platform congestion and service variability are excluded.
units.verify: 以連續列車的實際到站時間與逐車廂乘載量重算，將未登車人數保留在隊列，不以列車額定容量代替實際服務量。 逐列核對上車、下車與留下人數的守恆，並以同一計數時間窗比較需求和服務量。~Recalculate from consecutive arrival times and individual car loads. Carry passengers unable to board into the queue instead of treating rated capacity as delivered service. Check conservation of boarding, alighting and remaining passengers for every train, using identical counting windows for demand and delivered service.
units.failure: 某一列延誤會使後車追近而前方隊列累積；只看小時平均會漏掉最擁擠列車與長等待尾端。 應查驗未登車隊列，避免把滿載通過當成需求已服務。~A delayed train lets following trains bunch while the upstream queue grows; an hourly mean hides both the fullest train and the long-wait tail. Inspect passengers left behind instead of interpreting a full passing train as demand served.
units.misconception: 只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半~Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
units.practice: 用一組規則班距與一組相同平均值的不規則班距，追蹤每班留下的人數，解釋理論容量與可用容量的差距。 再以本單元 headway 的對照值重算 capacity，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare regular and irregular headways with the same mean, track passengers left behind after each departure, and explain the gap between theoretical and usable capacity. Also recalculate capacity for the alternative headway value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.title: 車門交換與停站時間~Door exchange and dwell time
units.mechanism: 停站時間由車門開關、旅客交換與確認安全三部分組成。把旅客平均分到所有車門只是基準，樓梯位置會使某幾扇門超載；最慢的門組可能控制全列發車，因此不能只用平均流率。 均分模型是檢查單位和量級的起點；真實發車須等最後必要門組完成。上車和下車方向互相干擾時，應用分階段或逐門事件模型重新識別流率。 把樓梯附近的車門視為獨立服務群，檢查不均勻上車。~Dwell time comprises door movement, passenger exchange and confirmation before departure. Equal distribution across doors is only a baseline: stair placement can overload selected doors. The slowest door group may govern departure of the entire train, so average flow alone is insufficient. Uniform allocation is a starting point for units and scale, while actual departure waits for the last required door group. If boarding and alighting interfere, use phased or door-by-door event models to identify the relevant exchange rates. Treat doors beside the stairs as a distinct service group and test uneven boarding.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s；計算：dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s。敏感度：exchange 將整數計數增加到 270至 270 persons，其餘固定，結果為 26.0625 s。模型邊界：均勻分配旅客與固定單門流率；不含對向人流衝突。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: exchange=245 persons; doors=24 doors; rate=0.8 persons/(door*s); fixed=12 s; calculation: dwell=exchange/(doors*rate)+fixed=24.76042 s. Sensitivity: exchange, increase the integer count to 270, to 270 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 26.0625 s. Model boundary: Uniform passenger distribution and fixed per-door flow; opposing-flow conflicts are excluded.
units.verify: 逐門標註下車、上車與關門事件，檢查樓梯附近門組是否偏慢，再以各門最大完成時間對照整列停站時間。 以影片事件時間和門控紀錄交叉對時，分別統計交換完成與發車確認的尾端分布。~Annotate alighting, boarding and closure at each door, check slow groups near stairs, and compare the latest completion time with whole-train dwell. Synchronise video event times with door-controller logs and separately report the tails of exchange completion and departure confirmation.
units.failure: 行李卡門或乘客集中會讓均勻模型低估尾端；延長關門提示可能改善秩序，也可能提高固定停站時間。 先核對門口人數，避免把旅客集中誤診為門機速度下降。~Luggage obstruction and clustered passengers make the uniform model underestimate the tail; a longer closing warning may improve order while increasing the fixed dwell component. Check doorway demand before misdiagnosing passenger concentration as slower door machinery.
units.misconception: 每扇門的平均流率相同就能忽略乘客分布差異~Equal average door flow rates make passenger distribution irrelevant to dwell time.
units.practice: 將一半上車需求集中在四分之一車門，重算最慢門組；提出導引與月台配置改進並區分其對固定時間和交換時間的作用。 再以本單元 exchange 的對照值重算 dwell，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Concentrate half the demand at one quarter of the doors, recalculate the slowest group, and distinguish guidance changes affecting fixed time from those affecting exchange time. Also recalculate dwell for the alternative exchange value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位~Stopping error and platform-door alignment
units.mechanism: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 將停準、門位和測量誤差分開，檢查月台門對位的不確定度。~Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Separate stopping, door-position and survey errors when checking platform-door alignment uncertainty.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.08976 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09317649 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.08976 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09317649 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified.
units.verify: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。~Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution.
units.failure: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。~Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset.
units.misconception: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移~A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
units.practice: 把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆~Platform storage and queue conservation
units.mechanism: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 以轉乘列車批次到達測試等候區占用與通道淨寬。~Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Test waiting-area occupation and clear circulation width under batch arrivals from connecting trains.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=428 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.222857 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 471至 471 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.345714 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=428 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.222857 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 471, to 471 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.345714 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.
units.verify: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。~Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.
units.failure: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。~A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.
units.misconception: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞~Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
units.practice: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 折返作業與路徑占用~Turnback and route occupation
units.title: 折返作業與路徑占用~Turnback and route occupation
units.mechanism: 終端折返的限制可能來自進站清空、換端、道岔鎖閉或離站衝突。將事件畫成時間線才能分辨能平行的任務與必須串接的任務；簡單加總是一條明示串聯路徑，不是所有終端的通用最小班距。 只要有兩條路徑共享道岔或保護區，表面上分開的月台仍可能互相限制。時序模型應包含占用開始、列車清空和進路釋放三個不同時間，而非一個站停數字。 觀察終端進站、換端和離站哪個互斥事件控制下一班。~A terminus may be constrained by approach clearance, cab change, point locking or conflicting departure routes. An event timeline separates parallel tasks from mandatory serial tasks. A simple sum represents one declared serial path, rather than a universal minimum headway for every terminal layout. Platforms that appear separate can still constrain each other through shared points or protection zones. A sequence model needs distinct times for occupation, physical clearance and route release rather than representing all three by one station dwell value. Identify which conflicting arrival, reversal or departure event controls the following service.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s；計算：cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s。敏感度：reverse 單獨增加百分之十至 84.15 s，其餘固定，結果為 144.15 s。模型邊界：單一折返路徑且三項活動不可重疊；不含備用月台與延誤恢復。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: arrival=35 s; reverse=76.5 s; release=25 s; calculation: cycle=arrival+reverse+release=136.5 s. Sensitivity: reverse, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 84.15 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 144.15 s. Model boundary: One turnback route with three nonoverlapping activities; spare platforms and delay recovery are excluded.
units.verify: 把軌道占用、道岔位置與駕駛換端紀錄放在同一時間軸，逐項檢查是否存在未被模型表示的互斥條件。 用占用指示與實際尾端清空時間互證，並列出各活動能否平行及其必要前置事件。~Place track occupation, point position and cab-change logs on one timeline, then identify exclusion conditions omitted by the simplified sequence. Cross-check occupation indication against actual rear-end clearance and list whether each task can overlap and which preceding events it requires.
units.failure: 只縮短換端時間而未解除路徑衝突，未必能縮短班距；錯把進路解鎖時間當成列車清空時間也會低估占用。 若尾端尚未清空，不能以換端完成取代進路釋放證據。~Reducing cab-change time cannot remove an unresolved route conflict; confusing route release with physical clearance also understates occupation time. Cab-change completion cannot substitute for route-release evidence while the train rear remains uncleared.
units.misconception: 換端作業加快多少秒最小班距就一定縮短相同秒數~Every second saved in cab change always removes one second from minimum headway.
units.practice: 畫出單月台與雙月台折返的甘特圖，標註不可同時使用的路徑，並以一班晚到列車檢查延誤是否傳到下一班。 再以本單元 reverse 的對照值重算 cycle，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Draw single-platform and dual-platform turnback timelines, mark mutually exclusive routes, and introduce one late train to test propagation into the next departure. Also recalculate cycle for the alternative reverse value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.mechanism: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 比較市區短站距煞車頻率與受電列車的時間重疊。~Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare frequent braking on urban station spacing with temporal overlap of receptive trains.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 269280 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.19375 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=244800 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=13.8125 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 269280 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.19375 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.
units.verify: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。~Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.
units.failure: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。~Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.
units.misconception: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網~Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
units.practice: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間~Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
units.mechanism: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 在地下站內分開一般換氣估算與火災排煙的設計問題。~A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Separate an underground station air-change estimate from the distinct design problem of smoke control.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 28.05 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 246.2658 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 28.05 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 246.2658 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded.
units.verify: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。~Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source.
units.failure: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。~Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources.
units.misconception: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降~A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
units.practice: 對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.title: 集水與排水容量~Catchment inflow and drainage capacity
units.mechanism: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 把入口集水範圍與抽水機啟停水位連成體積平衡。~A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Connect the entrance catchment and pump switching levels through a volume balance.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.244e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.343332 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.244e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.343332 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.
units.verify: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。~Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.
units.failure: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。~Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.
units.misconception: 排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位~A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
units.practice: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.title: 里程融合與不確定度~Position fusion and uncertainty
units.mechanism: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 對連續地下區間加入里程誤差，說明校正標誌的重要性。~Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Introduce odometry error in a continuous underground section and examine correction references.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.488 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.826817 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.488 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.826817 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.
units.verify: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。~Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.
units.failure: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。~A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.
units.misconception: 兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差~Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
units.practice: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 將垂直移動與平面步行分開，檢查轉乘時間的分布。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Separate vertical circulation from level walking and inspect the distribution of transfer times.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 m，其餘固定，結果為 53.04 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 53.04 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

facts: 已查證背景：1997 年，淡水線開始營運成為臺北捷運早期路線。~Verified background: 1997, The Tamsui line opened as an early Taipei Metro route.
教學假設，單元 1：headway=183.6 s/train，計算 capacity=17647.06 persons/hour；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 1: headway=183.6 s/train, calculated capacity=17647.06 persons/hour; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 2：exchange=245 persons，計算 dwell=24.76042 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: exchange=245 persons, calculated dwell=24.76042 s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：stop_sigma=0.0816 m，計算 combined_sigma=0.08534378 m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: stop_sigma=0.0816 m, calculated combined_sigma=0.08534378 m; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：people=428 persons，計算 density=1.222857 persons/m^2；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: people=428 persons, calculated density=1.222857 persons/m^2; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 5：reverse=76.5 s，計算 cycle=136.5 s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 5: reverse=76.5 s, calculated cycle=136.5 s; not measured performance.
